12	2. **Open-book QA test plan (QA-first):** when dispatch provides **`upstream_map_checklist`**, read the frozen checklist MAP + checks early — it is the QA bar your build will be tested against (policy floor: 3–5 tab IA, feature expansion depth, in-app image slots, motion moments, IAP wiring, permission keys). Build to satisfy it with **real** implementations; shells that merely satisfy static wording fail the QA runtime pass and come back as bugs.
13	3. If dispatch provides **`upstream_map_pm_visuals`** and/or **`frame_paths`**: **read those key-frame references early** (layout hierarchy, density, empty states, visual differentiation) before scaffolding UI. Frames are **small visual-reconstruction references only** (not App Store art, not a substitute for In-app image slots). If **`slot_asset_paths`** is set: those files are **embeddable slot rasters** (no UI chrome) — **must** copy into `Assets.xcassets` and wire `Image(...)` for matching `design.md` `slot_id` in S5; do not prefer weak placeholders when a slot file exists. **Truth priority: build text (routes/states/ACC) > slot assets > frames > free taste.** If text and frames conflict, follow text and note the gap in your attempt MAP.

15	5. **Never** read `research/*` for packaging (office-hours, market essays, reverse audit, etc.). Humans only; not required for a complete package.

17	7. **Graph Gaps (when present):** If the stage prompt, feedback, verification MAP, or `runs/*/graph/STATE.md` includes a **## Gaps** table, **read it before scaffolding or large UI edits**. This attempt should attack the highest-severity open dimension (`G1`…`G6`) / `suggested_node` (`build` / `build_ui` / …). Default is **refine**, not ignore. Note which gap_ids you addressed in your attempt MAP. See `docs/graph-quality-convergence.md`.

27	  | frame_id | path | used_for |
28	  | … | … | Tab IA / density / … |

30	- slot_assets_used:
31	  | slot_id | path | imageset_or_view |
32	  | … | … | Assets.xcassets/… or Image("…") |
33	- slot_assets_ignored: none | <literal reason>
34	```

37	
38	Typical `build/*` chapters (follow MAP reading order; do not invent chapters):
39	
40	- `product.md`, `routes-and-states.md`, `data-model.md`, `features.md`
41	- `ai-and-privacy.md`, `design.md`, `acceptance.md`, `non-goals.md`

46	
47	| Artifact | Role |

49	| **Real SwiftUI app repo** under the assigned product repo path | **Main** deliverable: Xcode project, agent-authored Sources, working routes/state |

60

Prefer real rasters when available. **Order:** (a) matching file from **`slot_asset_paths` / pm_visuals `slots/<slot_id>.*`** → copy bytes into Asset Catalog imageset named after `slot_id`; (b) else author a simple domain PNG; (c) **Empty fallback** (SF Symbol) only for empty/missing content state — the **slot UI must still exist**. 78	
79	Truth priority: **build text motion moments/ACC > free taste**.

85	- **Swift 5 / SwiftUI** product under assigned `product_repo_dir` (or job-equivalent path).

88	- Honor acceptance/non-goals from build docs without inventing scope.
89	- Do not create a delivery loop, package queue, planning sidecar tree, or FinalGate/delivery claim.
90	- Do not dispatch downstream agents; bounded rough-app job only.

92	## Blockers
93	
94	If you cannot complete (missing PM MAP, unreadable product path, credential packaging failure, unresolvable build error), leave a short attempt root `MAP.md` that states **what shipped** and **literal known gaps/blockers**. Do not fabricate green status or silent partial AI. Missing image slots after S5 → list `slot_id` gaps literally (do not claim visual-complete).
95	
96	If PM MAP or a MAP-listed critical `build/*` path is missing/unreadable → `Status: blocked` with literal `map_inputs_incomplete:<path-or-section>` (MAP contract defect). Do not invent product direction to fill holes.

1	# Product · TourWise — Home Viewing Scorecard
2	
3	## 一句话产品
4	TourWise 是本地优先、零账号的 iPhone 看房决策助手：看房现场按房间拍证据照并打分，回家用可调权重横向对比所有看过的房，导出一张结论卡说服自己与家人。不做房源搜索、不做账号云同步、不做 AI。
5	
6	- category_skeleton: `decision_assistant`(compare options → recommend → choose;非 log_record_archive)
7	- ia_shape: `tab_3_to_5`(4 个 task-distinct 主 tab:Viewings / Compare / Criteria / Settings)
8	- remote_ai: **no**(工厂 relay key 当前不可用；产品本身也不需要 AI 完成核心闭环)
9	- UI 语言:en-US(本文档记录 en-US copy 意图)
10	
11	## 用户与场景
12	正在密集看房(1–2 周看 5–15 套)的租房者与首套购房者，单人或与伴侣共同决策。事件型高价值使用：单次决策牵涉数千到数十万美元，使用频次低但每次会话密度极高。典型时刻：一天连看 4 套，第 4 套出来时第 1 套的厨房已经想不起来。
13	
14	## 核心闭环(core loop)
15	1. New Viewing → 录入地址/租金等基础信息(30 秒内可开始打分)。
16	2. Walkthrough 引导流：按房间(Kitchen / Living / Bedroom / Bath / Building / Outdoor)逐项打分(1–5)、拍证据照、一句话备注；可跳过任何项。
17	3. 回到 Viewings：每套房有完成度与均分；标记 toured / shortlist / rejected。
18	4. Compare：选 2–5 套 shortlist，按当前 WeightProfile 加权排序，逐指标并排对比。
19	5. Verdict：生成结论卡(排名 + 关键证据照 + 权重依据),导出到相册或系统分享(消耗 1 枚 Export Credit)。
20	6. 下周末再看新房 → 加入对比，排序自动更新。
21	
22	## 差异化(wedge)
23	唯一把「现场证据 → 加权排序 → 可分享结论」串成闭环的本地零账号产品。证据照绑定房间而非相册散片；权重模型是一等产品对象而非写死 checklist;Verdict 卡是决策的交付物。
24	
25	## 硬边界
26	- 不做房源搜索/聚合(那是 Zillow/Trulia 的战场，network moat)。
27	- 不做账号、云同步、多人实时协作(v0 单设备;Verdict 卡导出即协作接口)。
28	- 不做 AI 打分/AI 建议(remote_ai: no,见 ai-and-privacy.md)。
29	- 不做房东/物业巡检视角(RentCheck 的市场)。
30	- 不做完整搬家管理(搬家清单、utilities 迁移是 v1+ 候选)。
31	
32	## 市场供给与立场(proceed_narrow_wedge 必填)
33	竞争带:med collision / red heat(red 来自 L0 弱匹配门户，直接 job 近乎无人服务)。
34	
35	- 不与 HotPads(trackId 345957475,https://apps.apple.com/us/app/hotpads-apartment-rentals/id345957475)、Zumper(678683201,https://apps.apple.com/us/app/zumper-apartment-finder/id678683201)竞争：它们止步于找房与约看,saved homes 无逐房间评分与权重比较——我们不碰房源发现。
36	- 不与 RentCheck(1134017691,https://apps.apple.com/us/app/rentcheck/id1134017691)竞争：房东巡检工作流，非租客决策比较。
37	- 直接同形者 Home Hunter - Smart Checklist(6754038639,https://apps.apple.com/us/app/home-hunter-smart-checklist/id6754038639)与 Home viewing - house checklist(6774289434,https://apps.apple.com/us/app/home-viewing-house-checklist/id6774289434)均 0 评分、无迭代证据；我们的区别 = photo-evidence 绑定 + 权重模型 + verdict 导出闭环，三者缺一即塌缩为 clone(non-goals 已镜像)。
38	- 只竞争面：tour 之后的 30 分钟决策窗口。
39	
40	## 商业化(详见 ai-and-privacy.md Commerce card)
41	StoreKit consumable(yanran balance catalog):Export Credit。核心打分/对比永久免费；导出 Verdict 卡消耗 1 枚；新用户首启赠 100 枚(yanran initial_balance=100)；售 473900(110 枚,$0.99)/ 473901(210 枚,$1.99)两档包。无订阅、无解锁制、无 Restore Purchases 入口(consumable 语义)。

1	# Routes & States · TourWise
2	
3	命名即代码标识(SwiftUI route id / view 名同形)。en-US copy 为下游实现真源。
4	
5	## Navigation shell(硬规则:多主任务 + 记录生命周期 → TabView 4 tab)
6	| tab | route_id | 主任务 | 保留状态 |
7	|-----|----------|--------|----------|
8	| Viewings | `tab_viewings` | 管理所有看房记录(建/查/筛) | 选中 filter、进行中的 viewing |
9	| Compare | `tab_compare` | 选 shortlist → 加权对比 → 出 verdict | 已选 viewing 集合 |
10	| Criteria | `tab_criteria` | 管理评分指标与权重方案 | 编辑中的 WeightProfile |
11	| Settings | `tab_settings` | 积分、隐私、导出、关于 | — |
12	
13	## Route 表
14	| route_id | 类型 | 入口 | 用途 |
15	|----------|------|------|------|
16	| `tab_viewings` | tab root | 启动默认 | Viewing 列表(status 分组:shortlist / toured / rejected),hero 区,空态插画 |
17	| `viewing_detail` | push | tab_viewings 行 | 单套详情:基本信息、逐房间评估、证据照条、均分、状态切换 |
18	| `viewing_edit` | sheet | viewing_detail / tab_viewings + | 新建/编辑基础信息(title/address/rent/beds/baths/notes) |
19	| `capture_walkthrough` | full-screen cover | viewing_detail "Start Walkthrough" / tab_viewings 新建后自动 | 引导多步打分流:房间步进(stepper),每步 score 1–5 + 拍照/选图 + 备注,可跳过/提前结束 |
20	| `room_capture` | capture_walkthrough 子页 | 步进 | 单房间:camera capture / Photos pick / 跳过,绑定 RoomNote |
21	| `tab_compare` | tab root | tab | shortlist 选择器 + 加权排名列表(条柱 + 得分) |
22	| `compare_board` | push | tab_compare(≥2 套) | 并排对比表:行=指标(加权),列=viewing;证据照缩略;权重来源标注 |
23	| `verdict_card` | sheet | compare_board "Make Verdict" | 结论卡预览(排名 + 3 张关键证据 + 权重依据),Save to Photos / Share,消耗 1 Export Credit |
24	| `tab_criteria` | tab root | tab | 指标列表(内置 + 自定义),启停、排序 |
25	| `criterion_edit` | sheet | tab_criteria | 新建/编辑指标(name、icon、说明) |
26	| `weight_editor` | push | tab_criteria WeightProfile 行 | 权重滑杆组,总和=100% 实时校验;多方案保存/切换 |
27	| `tab_settings` | tab root | tab | Export Credit 余额与购买入口、隐私入口、数据导出(JSON)、关于 |
28	| `paywall` | sheet | tab_settings "Buy Credits" / verdict_card 余额不足 | consumable 商品列表(473900: 110 credits / 473901: 210 credits),StoreKit 购买 |
29	| `privacy` | push | tab_settings | 数据边界说明(全本地)、权限状态信息、删除全部数据 |
30	
31	## 关键状态机
32	### Viewing.status
33	`draft`(建了未走完)→ `toured`(walkthrough 完成或手动标记)→ `shortlisted` → `rejected`;`toured/shortlisted/rejected` 可互转,`draft` 完成 walkthrough 即 `toured`。
34	
35	### capture_walkthrough 步进
36	room_queue = 启用的 RoomType 序列;每房间状态:`pending` / `scored` / `skipped`;允许任意顺序跳转、随时 Finish(finish 时 pending 记为 skipped)。中断后从 viewing_detail "Resume Walkthrough" 恢复现场。
37	
38	### 权限与恢复(硬规则:禁止 Open Settings 文案/跳转;拒绝后保留应用内继续)
39	| 场景 | 状态 | en-US 行为与文案 |
40	|------|------|------------------|
41	| 相机首次 | pre-prompt → system prompt | 仅在 room_capture 点 "Take Photo" 时请求(just-in-time);usage 文案:"TourWise uses the camera to attach evidence photos to the room you are scoring." |
42	| 相机 denied/restricted | capture_denied | 原位卡片:"Camera is off for TourWise. You can **Choose Photo** from your library, **Add without a photo**, or **Retry Camera**." — 三按钮均在应用内;禁止出现 Settings 字样/跳转 |
43	| 无相机硬件(模拟器) | camera_unavailable | 自动隐藏 Take Photo,保留 Choose Photo / Add without a photo |
44	| 相册读 limited/denied | photos_read_limited | 选图器空态:"No photos available. You can **Take Photo** or **Add without a photo**." |
45	| 相册写 denied(导出) | photos_write_denied | Verdict 卡原位提示:"Saving to Photos is off. You can still **Share** the card." Share 路径不依赖写权限 |
46	| StoreKit 失败 | purchase_failed | toast:"Purchase didn't complete. Your credits were not changed. **Try Again**" |
47	| 余额不足 | credits_empty | verdict_card CTA 变 "Get Credits" → paywall;不阻断预览 |
48	
49	### 全局 en-US 反馈(样例真源)
50	- 保存 viewing:"Viewing saved." / 删除确认:"Delete this viewing? Its scores and photos will be removed from this iPhone."
51	- walkthrough 完成:"Walkthrough complete — nice evidence. See how it ranks in Compare."
52	- compare 不足 2 套:"Shortlist at least 2 viewings to compare."
53	- verdict 导出成功:"Verdict card saved to Photos." / 分享:系统 share sheet。
54	- 空态(home):"No viewings yet. Add your first tour and score it room by room."
55	- 键盘:所有输入框失焦/return 收起键盘。

1	# Data Model · TourWise
2	
3	全本地持久化(SwiftData 或等价本地存储);无网络、无账号。照片以本地文件 + 相对路径引用存储(禁止绝对路径),资产 id 不变量:删除 Viewing 级联删除其 RoomNote 与本地照片文件。
4	
5	## 实体
6	
7	### Viewing
8	| field | type | notes |
9	|-------|------|-------|
10	| id | UUID | pk |
11	| title | String | 默认 "123 Main St, Apt 4B" 由 address 派生,可改 |
12	| address | String | 必填(可短) |
13	| rentCents | Int? | 可选;展示 "$1,850/mo" |
14	| beds / baths | Int? / Double? | 可选 |
15	| status | enum: draft/toured/shortlisted/rejected | 见状态机 |
16	| visitedAt | Date | 默认 now |
17	| generalNotes | String | 可空 |
18	| createdAt / updatedAt | Date | |
19	
20	### RoomNote(房间评估,绑定证据)
21	| field | type | notes |
22	|-------|------|-------|
23	| id | UUID | pk |
24	| viewingId | UUID | fk → Viewing,级联删 |
25	| roomType | enum: kitchen/living/bedroom/bath/building/outdoor/custom(String) | 步进顺序由房间列表决定 |
26	| criterionScores | [UUID: Int] | criterionId → 1...5;只存已打分项 |
27	| note | String | 一句话备注,可空 |
28	| photoRelativePaths | [String] | 0..n,本地相对路径 |
29	| state | enum: pending/scored/skipped | walkthrough 步进用 |
30	
31	### Criterion(评分指标)
32	| field | type | notes |
33	|-------|------|-------|
34	| id | UUID | pk |
35	| name | String | 唯一(en-US) |
36	| sfSymbol | String | 展示图标 |
37	| isBuiltIn | Bool | 内置不可删,可停用 |
38	| isEnabled | Bool | 停用后不进 walkthrough/对比 |
39	| sortOrder | Int | |
40	
41	内置指标(seed):Natural Light / Noise / Space & Storage / Condition / Kitchen / Bathroom / Location & Commute / Building & Safety / Price Fit。
42	
43	### WeightProfile(权重方案,一等对象)
44	| field | type | notes |
45	|-------|------|-------|
46	| id | UUID | pk |
47	| name | String | 如 "Commute-first" |
48	| weights | [UUID: Int] | criterionId → 0...100,校验 Σ=100 |
49	| isActive | Bool | 全局恰一个 active |
50	| updatedAt | Date | |
51	
52	seed 一个 "Balanced" 默认方案(9 指标均分到和 100)。
53	
54	### ExportCreditLedger(consumable 余额)
55	| field | type | notes |
56	|-------|------|-------|
57	| balance | Int | ≥0;初始 100(首启 seed,yanran initial_balance=100) |
58	| transactions | [CreditTxn] | 追加式:grant(seed,+100)/purchase(productId ∈ {473900:+110, 473901:+210})/spend(verdictExport,-1) |
59	| updatedAt | Date | |
60	
61	### ExportRecord
62	| field | type | notes |
63	|-------|------|-------|
64	| id | UUID | pk |
65	| viewingIds | [UUID] | 参与对比的集合快照 |
66	| weightProfileId | UUID | 导出时使用的方案 |
67	| verdictPhotoRelativePath | String? | 若存相册成功则记录渲染卡本地副本 |
68	| createdAt | Date | |
69	
70	## 关系与不变量
71	- Viewing 1—n RoomNote;RoomNote.photoRelativePaths 指向 app 沙盒 `Photos/<viewingId>/<uuid>.jpg`。
72	- 加权得分 = Σ(score[c] × weight[c]) / Σ(weight[c] over 已打分且启用指标);缺分指标按"已打分归一化",不惩罚未打分房间——compare_board 对缺分单元格显示 "—"。
73	- 删除 WeightProfile:不允许删 active/最后一个;引用了它的 ExportRecord 保留快照不级联。
74	- 余额不变量:导出成功才 spend;StoreKit 交易 finish 前不落 purchase 入账;spend 与渲染必须同事务(渲染失败退款)。

1	# Design · TourWise
2	
3	## Visual direction
4	"Evidence board on warm paper":温暖纸感底色 + 拍立得式证据照卡 + 自信的数据排版。看房是高压决策,界面要像一个可以信赖的桌面证据板——照片是主角,分数与权重是冷静的衬线数字,操作克制。避免 portals 的冷蓝 listing 风,也避免通用 checklist 的灰白工具感。
5	
6	- Palette(可测量):
7	  - bg_paper `#F6F1E7`(主背景,全页面完整铺底,非纯白)
8	  - bg_panel `#FFFFFF`(卡片)
9	  - ink_primary `#2B2620`
10	  - accent_brass `#B4762A`(主操作/排名 #1)
11	  - accent_sage `#6E7F5C`(shortlist/正向)
12	  - warn_terracotta `#B4503C`(rejected/删除)
13	  - score_track `#E4DCCB`(条柱轨道)
14	- Type:系统字体;页面标题 28/34 semibold,分区标题 17/22 semibold,正文 15/20 regular,分数数字 20/24 medium tabular-nums。
15	- 形状:卡片圆角 14,照片卡圆角 10 带 1pt `#00000010` 描边与 8% 旋转 ≤1.2° 的拍立得微倾斜(仅证据照,不用于数据表)。
16	- en-US chrome 样例:tab 标题 "Viewings / Compare / Criteria / Settings";主 CTA "Start Walkthrough" / "Make Verdict";空态标题 "No viewings yet"。
17	
18	## In-app image slots (required)
19	
20	| slot_id | kind | route_id | component | purpose | asset_or_source | empty_fallback | acc_ids |
21	|---------|------|----------|-----------|---------|-----------------|----------------|---------|
22	| `app_icon` | app_icon | n/a | asset catalog AppIcon imageset | 商店/主屏图标:暖纸底 + 黄铜色房屋+星标组合 | pm_visuals 交付 1024px 图标 → Asset Catalog | 不可用(构建必需) | ACC-VIS-ICON |
23	| `home_hero` | hero | tab_viewings | `Image`(asset `hero_home`)+ 渐变遮罩 + 标题叠层 | 首页顶部品牌/域主视觉(暖调客厅窗台光),确立"证据板"气质 | pm_visuals `slots/home_hero.png` 或等值生成资产 | 纯 `#E9DFC9` 渐变 + SF Symbol `house.fill` | ACC-VIS-HERO |
24	| `viewings_empty_illustration` | empty_illustration | tab_viewings | `Image`(asset `empty_viewings`)居中空态插画 | 空列表引导:拍立得叠 + 星标,配 "No viewings yet" 与 Add 按钮 | pm_visuals `slots/viewings_empty_illustration.png` | SF Symbol `photo.stack` 56pt accent_brass 40% | ACC-VIS-EMPTY |
25	| `room_photo_slot` | photo_or_media | room_capture | 照片预览 `Image`(本地文件)/ Photos picker 缩略 | 逐房间证据照采集与预览(用户拍摄/选取),绑定 RoomNote | 用户相机拍摄 / 相册选取(本地相对路径) | 虚线相框 + SF Symbol `camera.fill` + "Add photo evidence" | ACC-VIS-MEDIA |
26	| `detail_photo_strip` | photo_or_media | viewing_detail | 横向 ScrollView 证据照条(本地 `Image`),点击全屏查看 | 单套房的证据回溯(核心痛点"第 1 套厨房什么样") | RoomNote.photoRelativePaths 本地文件 | 无照时不渲染条,显示 "No photos yet — add during a walkthrough" 文本行 | ACC-VIS-MEDIA |
27	| `verdict_card_render` | photo_or_media | verdict_card | 渲染视图(排名 + 证据照合成)预览 `Image` | 结论卡预览与导出成品 | 本地渲染(RoomNote 照片合成) | 无证据照时以纯色块 + 分数排版渲染(不阻断导出) | ACC-VIS-MEDIA |
28	| `criterion_icons` | extra(icon) | tab_criteria | 资产图标集/ SF Symbol 映射 | 指标识别(灯泡=Natural Light、耳朵=Noise…) | 内置资产或 SF Symbol 映射表 | SF Symbol `checklist` | ACC-VIS-ICON |
29	
30	规则落实:slot 全唯一;`asset_or_source` 均指向 slot 级资产或本地文件,不指向整屏 frame;empty_fallback 全部声明;四类必需 kind(app_icon/hero/empty_illustration/photo_or_media)齐全。
31	
32	## Motion & interaction language (required)
33	
34	### Motion thesis
35	证据落板,结论浮现:每一次打分与拍照都是把一张证据"按"在证据板上,而对比与结论则以克制的生长与落位浮现——动效服务于"从混乱到确定"的决策情绪,而非装饰。
36	
37	### Shared motion tokens
38	| token | value | usage |
39	|-------|-------|-------|
40	| `dur_settle` | 0.28s spring(response 0.28, damping 0.82) | 证据卡落位、列表插入 |
41	| `dur_grow` | 0.45s easeOut | 对比条柱、排名变化 |
42	| `dur_deal` | 0.5s spring(response 0.5, damping 0.75) | Verdict 卡发牌式出现 |
43	| `haptic_commit` | UIImpactFeedbackGenerator .medium | 打分提交、照片落位 |
44	| `haptic_verdict` | UINotificationFeedbackGenerator .success | 导出成功 |
45	| `stagger_room` | 0.06s | walkthrough 房间步进切换 |
46	
47	### Product moments
48	| moment_id | route_id | trigger | user_value | motion_behavior | haptic | reduce_motion_equivalent | acc_id |
49	|-----------|----------|---------|------------|-----------------|--------|--------------------------|--------|
50	| `mot_entry_settle` | tab_viewings | 冷启动/回首页首帧 | 第一眼确立"证据板"信息重心 | hero 轻微下沉落位(dur_settle),viewing 卡自下而上 0.06s stagger 入场 | 无 | 直接静态呈现终态,无位移 | ACC-MOT-ENTRY |
51	| `mot_commit_photo` | room_capture | 拍摄/选图确认 | 确认"证据已绑定这个房间" | 照片缩略从预览区飞入房间卡照片位并落板(dur_settle + 1.2° 微倾斜),房间卡短暂抬升 2pt 回弹 | haptic_commit | 照片即时静态落位 + 60ms 透明度淡入 | ACC-MOT-COMMIT |
52	| `mot_success_verdict` | verdict_card | "Make Verdict" 点击 | 决策交付的仪式感 | 结论卡以发牌式从上沿滑入并轻微回正(dur_deal),#1 排名徽标随后 0.15s 弹入 | haptic_verdict(导出成功时) | 卡片无位移直接呈现,徽标以透明度淡入 | ACC-MOT-SUCCESS |
53	| `mot_empty_breathe` | tab_viewings | 列表为空展示空态 | 空态不"死",引导首个动作 | 空态插画 2.4s 周期 ±4pt 呼吸浮动,Add 按钮同步 5% 亮度脉动一次后静止 | 无 | 静态插画 + 静态按钮 | ACC-MOT-EMPTY |
54	| `mot_rank_regrow` | tab_compare / compare_board | 切换 active WeightProfile | 权重变化"看得见"地影响结论 | 条柱以 dur_grow 重生长到新值,排名位移用 matchedGeometry 换位 | 无 | 数值即时更新,条柱无动画 | ACC-MOT-COMMIT |
55	
56	### Forbidden
57	- 禁止任何自动轮播/无限循环装饰动画(证据板是冷静工具)。
58	- 禁止页面级粒子/ confetti(包括导出成功;仪式感由发牌动效承担)。
59	- 禁止拍照后的强制全屏"欣赏"转场打断 walkthrough 节奏。
60	- 禁止把 rank 变化做成闪烁/颜色爆闪。
61	
62	## Visual frames(pm_visuals 整屏参考,≤6)
63	| frame_id | route_id | purpose | layout skeleton | density | avoid |
64	|----------|----------|---------|-----------------|---------|-------|
65	| `frame_home` | tab_viewings | 首页:hero + viewing 卡列表 | 顶 hero(30% 屏高)+ 分组列表卡 + tab bar | mid | 冷蓝 listing 风 |
66	| `frame_home_empty` | tab_viewings | 空态 | 居中插画 + 标题 + 单 CTA | low | 纯文字空态 |
67	| `frame_walkthrough` | room_capture | 打分采集 | 顶部房间步进条 + 照片位(40%)+ 1–5 分排 + 备注行 | mid | 表单堆叠 |
68	| `frame_compare` | compare_board | 并排对比 | 左指标列 + 横向滑动 viewing 列 + 顶排名条 | high | 拥挤小字 |
69	| `frame_verdict` | verdict_card | 结论卡 | 卡片居中(60%)+ 底部 Save/Share 双按钮 | mid | 系统弹窗感 |
70	| `frame_paywall` | paywall | 积分购买 | 余额卡 + 两档商品卡 + 说明 | low | 订阅话术 |
71	
72	pm_visuals 可按 slot_id 额外产出 `slots/<slot_id>.png` 嵌入位图;slot_id 保持文件名安全。整屏 frame 仅作布局参考,不接进 `asset_or_source`。
73	
74	## Accessibility
75	- Dynamic Type 到 AX3;分数/权重数字 tabular-nums;对比表横滑列头固定。
76	- 所有照片位有 accessibilityLabel("Kitchen evidence photo 1 of 3");打分控件可读值("4 of 5 for Natural Light")。
77	- 对比表颜色不单独承载排名(同时给 #1/#2 文本徽标);Reduce Motion 见上表逐条等价。
78	- 最小布局 320×568 不溢出:walkthrough 打分排改为纵向 5 行;对比表列宽 ≥132pt 横滑。

7	
8	**Default on for rough_app / package delivery.** PM packages **must** declare In-app image slots; this skill wires them into the product repo.
9	
10	Use whenever `build/design.md` has **In-app image slots (required)** (or the four required kinds are missing and must still be implemented with Gaps). Also covers optional extra slots (category icons, receipts, etc.).
11	
12	## Contract
13	
14	- **Mandatory kinds:** `app_icon`, `hero`, `empty_illustration`, `photo_or_media` (user photo/media surface **or** domain content image region).
15	- Wire every PM table row into Asset Catalog / SwiftUI (`Image`, `AsyncImage`, picker thumbnail, etc.) on the declared route.
16	- Keep assets replaceable and product-specific.
17	- Do not copy reference-app branding or vendor artwork.
18	- Empty/fallback (SF Symbol) is allowed **inside** a slot; **dropping the slot** is not.
19	- Preserve PM design direction / frames fingerprint when present; avoid visual collision with reference apps.
20	- Record missing final artwork as a literal asset/Gaps line instead of silently dropping the slot.
21	
22	## Upstream slot assets (when present)
23	
24	Dispatch may include **`slot_asset_paths`** (or files under pm_visuals attempt `slots/`). These are **embeddable** rasters produced for slot wiring — **not** whole-screen layout frames.
25	
26	1. Match path stem / filename to `design.md` `slot_id` when possible.
27	2. **Copy** the file into `Assets.xcassets/<slot_id>.imageset/` (plus `@2x`/`@3x` only if you genuinely scale; one scale is fine) and wire `Image("<slot_id>")` / App Icon as appropriate.
28	3. **Do not** ignore a present slot file in favor of a weak self-drawn placeholder or SF Symbol primary art.
29	4. **Do not** use `frames/*.png` (full UI mockups) as imageset binaries by default.
30	5. Missing `slot_asset_paths` is normal (best-effort upstream) — then author domain PNG or empty fallback inside the still-present slot UI.
31

33	
34	Write refs for asset catalogs, SwiftUI image slots, placeholder states, slot-asset copy sources, and remaining asset blockers (MAP Assets table, Upstream visuals `slot_assets_used`, or Gaps).

6	# Product Motion Language
7	
8	Produce **only** a mergeable markdown section for `build/design.md`. Do not write product source, do not invent features/routes/AI, and do not copy motion timing from reference apps or external vendors.
9	
10	## Output contract
11	
12	Emit exactly this section (English table headers):
13	
14	```markdown
15	## Motion & interaction language (required)
16	
17	### Motion thesis
18	<one sentence: how this product should feel during the core job>
19	
20	### Shared motion tokens
21	| token | value | usage |
22	|-------|-------|-------|
23	| … | … | … |
24	
25	### Product moments
26	| moment_id | route_id | trigger | user_value | motion_behavior | haptic | reduce_motion_equivalent | acc_id |
27	|-----------|----------|---------|------------|-----------------|--------|--------------------------|--------|
28	| … | … | … | … | … | … | … | ACC-MOT-… |
29	
30	### Forbidden
31	- <product-specific anti-patterns>
32	```
33	
34	## Hard rules
35	
36	1. **Product-bound** — `Motion thesis` and every moment must derive from this package's `product.md` one-liner / core loop / wedge. Do not emit a universal “every app needs entry fade + button scale” template.
37	2. **Minimum coverage** — at least **4** `Product moments`, spanning:
38	   - first meaningful entry / home arrival,
39	   - primary user commit or creation,
40	   - success / confirmed result,
41	   - empty / error / recovery state.
42	3. **Route-bound** — every `route_id` must exist in `build/routes-and-states.md`.
43	4. **ACC mirror** — every `acc_id` must appear in `build/acceptance.md` as `ACC-MOT-*` with an observable pass condition.

45	6. **Diversity check** — before finalizing, self-check against recent package motion languages (use PM dedupe context / recent MAPs when available). Avoid literal repeats of thesis + moment behavior across packages; if overlap is high, write the differentiation reason in the thesis.
46	7. **Restraint** — prefer 1–3 signature motions that explain state; forbid decorative loops, blocking transitions, and celebration unrelated to a real user milestone.

49

Status: ready

TourWise 是本地优先、零账号的 iPhone 看房决策助手:看房现场按房间拍证据照并打分,用可调权重横向对比所有看过的房,导出 Verdict 结论卡。remote_ai = no;IAP = yanran consumable Export Credit(473900/473901,首启 seed 100)。

- Path: `runs/kf-20260727T062537Z-62cc68a6/product`(XcodeGen `project.yml` → `TourWise.xcodeproj`;Xcode 26.4.1,iOS 17+ target,iPhone only)

- **14 routes 全实现**(routes-and-states.md):`tab_viewings`(hero + status 分组 + 搜索 + 空态)、`viewing_detail`(证据照条/房间卡/状态切换/级联删除)、`viewing_edit`、`capture_walkthrough` + `room_capture`(步进/乱序/跳过/中断恢复/finish 汇总)、`tab_compare`(2–5 shortlist + 加权排名)、`compare_board`(固定指标列 + 横滑 viewing 列 ≥140pt + 缺分 "—")、`verdict_card`(渲染预览 + Save/Share)、`tab_criteria`、`criterion_edit`、`weight_editor`(Σ=100 实时校验阻存 + 差值提示)、`tab_settings`、`paywall`、`privacy`。
